related_questions.question: Does my wife get half of everything in a divorce in the UK?
related_questions.snippet: Half of all marital property, yes. This means houses and money acquired during a marriage, even if only one partner 'earnt' it all. This could also mean pre-marital property which was used as the marital home at some point during the marriage, if even for a short while.
